svg.title: Shrublab — Maple Mono extra-heavy italic, oscillating rising wave, horizontal
svg.desc: Shrublab v12 icon with darkened top-colour Maple Mono extra-heavy italic letterforms; two rising oscillating wave divisions and restored character spacing.
svg.metadata: Maple Mono Variable Italic (weight 800) glyphs outlined from user-supplied font and rendered with a heavy contour. No font files bundled.
